policy: Each required_facts item maps to actual question clauses. Contextual_background is explicitly not a scoring requirement. No unrelated source completeness caps.

questions.asked_clauses: How is a duel set up: cards and health, who places where and in what order, legal sidekick spaces including a multizone hero space, when is Alice’s initial size chosen, and who takes the first turn?
required_answer_facts: Choose a battlefield; each player takes their hero’s matching components and sets character-card starting health (undialed sidekicks have 1 health each)
Shuffle each 30-card deck separately and draw 5
Younger places hero on 1 then sidekicks in separate spaces sharing any zone of that hero; choose Alice’s size on placement
Older places hero on 2 then sidekicks by the same rules
Younger takes first turn

questions.asked_clauses: What actions must you take on a turn, may you repeat or skip an action, and when and how do you enforce the 7-card hand limit if you temporarily hold 9?
required_answer_facts: Take 2 actions from maneuver, scheme, attack; may repeat the same action but cannot skip
May hold 9 during turn; at end discard 2 to own discard pile to reach 7, then opponent’s turn

questions.asked_clauses: During an ordinary maneuver, in what order do drawing and movement occur, which fighters may move how far, and can you pass through friendly or enemy fighters, end on an occupied space, or interleave two fighters’ moves?
required_answer_facts: Draw 1 first, mandatory; movement optional
Each fighter may move 0 up to character move value along adjacent connected spaces, distances independently
Move one fighter completely before another in any order
May pass own friendly fighters but never end occupied; cannot pass opposing fighters

questions.asked_clauses: How do you BOOST maneuver movement, what happens to the discarded card’s printed effect, who receives the movement increase, and may a defeated sidekick’s unusable card pay for it?
required_answer_facts: Discard 1 hand card and add its BOOST value to movement value for the maneuver, applying to each fighter
Ignore discarded card’s effect
Cards unusable because their fighter is defeated may still be discarded to BOOST

questions.asked_clauses: Your empty deck is asked to draw 2 cards by a mandatory effect while your hero and a sidekick survive. Do you reshuffle or decline the draws, and what damage does each fighter take?
required_answer_facts: Do not reshuffle or decline; draws mandatory unless otherwise specified
Each failed draw immediately deals 2 damage to each fighter, thus 4 each over two draws if game continues and they survive; hero defeat ends game immediately

questions.asked_clauses: For a melee fighter and a ranged fighter, which targets are legal if adjacent across a zone boundary, nonadjacent in the same zone, or in a disconnected part of the same colored zone?
required_answer_facts: Both may target adjacent opposing fighters regardless of zone
Only ranged may target nonadjacent fighters in same zone, including separated parts of a same-pattern zone
Melee may only target adjacent fighters

questions.asked_clauses: When is an attack action illegal, who must be named as attacker, what cards may each combatant use, may the defender decline a card, and when are the cards revealed? How do versatile cards count for other effects?
required_answer_facts: Illegal without attack-capable card in hand or valid target for a fighter
Declare active attacking fighter and target; attack card must permit that fighter
Defender may decline; if defending use defense-capable card permitted for defending fighter
Cards placed face down attacker then defender and revealed simultaneously
Versatile usable for attack or defense and counts as both for other effects

questions.asked_clauses: Give the full combat resolution order, including simultaneous effect priority, whether effects are optional, other after-combat game effects and played-card destinations.
required_answer_facts: Resolve immediately effects then during-combat effects then combat damage/result then after-combat card effects then other after-combat game effects
At any same timing defender effect first
Card effects mandatory unless specified otherwise
Finally put played cards in respective face-up discard piles

questions.asked_clauses: An attack value 4 meets defense value 4, then a card effect deals 2 damage to the defender. Who won and why? With no defense card against an attack value 4, how much attack damage is dealt?
required_answer_facts: Equal values cause no attack damage; defender wins despite 2 effect damage
Winner determined only by damage from attack itself: at least 1 means attacker wins, none means defender wins
Undefended value 4 deals 4 attack damage

questions.asked_clauses: A sidekick reaches zero during combat but its hero lives; what happens to the token and its played card’s after-combat effect? What changes if instead a hero reaches zero, even if a later healing effect was pending?
required_answer_facts: Immediately remove defeated sidekick; its played after-combat effect still resolves if game not ended
Hero reaching zero immediately loses and game ends; no later healing or after-combat continuation can save it

questions.asked_clauses: How do you play and resolve a scheme, can you use a scheme restricted to a defeated fighter, and who may inspect whose discard pile when?
required_answer_facts: Play scheme face up from hand; declare a permitted active fighter; cannot play if listed fighters defeated
Resolve effect then place in own face-up discard pile
Both players may inspect either discard pile at any time

questions.asked_clauses: State Alice’s starting health, movement, attack type, Jabberwock stats, initial-size choice, and the combat bonuses for BIG and SMALL. Do the size bonuses apply to Jabberwock?
required_answer_facts: Alice 13 health, move 2, melee; Jabberwock 8 health, melee
Choose BIG or SMALL on Alice placement and track with size token
BIG adds 2 to Alice attack-card values; SMALL adds 1 to Alice defense-card values
Bonuses are Alice only, not Jabberwock

questions.asked_clauses: State Arthur and Merlin’s starting health, attack types and move value. When and how may Arthur boost an attack using his ability, and what if the opposing card cancels his attack-card effects?
required_answer_facts: Arthur 18 health melee; Merlin 7 health ranged; move 2
When Arthur attacks may play a BOOST card face down alongside attack card, adding its BOOST value to attack
If opponent cancels attack-card effects, BOOST discarded without effect
Ability applies to Arthur attacks

questions.asked_clauses: State Medusa’s starting health, move and attack type; her sidekicks’ number, health and attack type; and the timing, optionality, target and amount of her special ability.
required_answer_facts: Medusa 16 health, move 3, ranged
3 Harpies, 1 health each, melee
At start of own turn may deal 1 damage to one opposing fighter in Medusa’s zone

questions.asked_clauses: State Sinbad and Porter’s health and attack types and normal move value. With 3 Voyage cards already discarded, how far may each move in a maneuver and what is a newly played base-2 Voyage’s combat value before other modifiers? Does the played Voyage count itself yet?
required_answer_facts: Sinbad 15 health melee; Porter 6 health melee; move 2
Maneuver allowance 2+3=5 for each fighter
Voyage value 2+3=5; played card not yet discarded and does not count itself

questions.asked_clauses: What exactly do Alice’s Eat Me and Drink Me schemes do, in which order, and may she refuse the size change after taking their first benefit?
required_answer_facts: Eat Me moves Alice up to 3 spaces then changes size
Drink Me draws 2 cards then changes size
Change BIG to SMALL or SMALL to BIG; mandatory size change, even if Eat Me movement chosen as zero

questions.asked_clauses: Jabberwock attacks with Jaws That Bite, Arthur defends with Skirmish, both value 4. Arthur moves Jabberwock away so it has no adjacent fighters. Resolve damage, winner, timing and the Jaws effect. If a friendly fighter alone were adjacent instead, could Alice decline to damage it?
required_answer_facts: No attack damage; Arthur defender wins
Defender’s after-combat Skirmish moves one combatant up to 2 first
Then Jaws deals 2 to any one fighter adjacent to Jabberwock; none means no damage
If only friendly adjacent it must take 2, because effect mandatory and any fighter includes friendly
source_refs: rulebook p12–13; alice-action-cards.png r3c1–2; king-arthur-action-cards.png r4c1–3

questions.asked_clauses: Arthur uses The Holy Grail. At its after-combat timing he has respectively 4, 5, or 0 health. What happens in each case, and can any healing exceed the dial maximum?
required_answer_facts: At 4 (or less but above zero) set Arthur to 8
At 5 no healing from Grail
At 0 hero defeated and game already ended, no rescue
Fighters cannot gain health above dial maximum

questions.asked_clauses: What movement exception does Winged Frenzy grant, to which fighters and for how far? What happens afterward if a Harpy has been defeated, where may it return, and may it end on an occupied space?
required_answer_facts: Move each own fighter up to 3, may pass opposing fighters
Then return one defeated Harpy if any to any space in Medusa’s zone
Destinations must be unoccupied: one fighter per space

questions.asked_clauses: Sinbad plays Voyage Home with 4 other Voyages in his discard pile. If uncancelled and game continues, what is its value, what returns where after combat, where does Voyage Home itself end, and what is his next unboosted maneuver allowance?
required_answer_facts: Value 2+4=6 during combat
After combat return all other Voyage cards from discard to hand
Voyage Home then goes to discard at combat end
Only Voyage Home remains there so next maneuver allowance 2+1=3 for each own fighter

questions.asked_clauses: What does Regroup draw after combat if you win versus lose? If it is your defeated sidekick’s played card and the duel continues, does that draw still occur?
required_answer_facts: Win draws 2 instead of 1, not 3 total
Lose draws 1
Defeated sidekick’s played after-combat effect still resolves if duel continues
source_refs: all four action sheets: Regroup; rulebook p12

questions.asked_clauses: Your fighter plays Momentous Shift while in its turn-start space after moving away and back. Is the value 3 or 5? What if it is now in a different space from where it started this turn, including when defending on the opponent’s turn?
required_answer_facts: Same space as turn start means printed value 3
Different current space from where that fighter started this turn means value 5 instead
Test uses current turn, including opponent’s turn when defending; no requirement to be attacker
source_refs: alice-action-cards.png r3c5–6; king-arthur-action-cards.png r4c4–6; sinbad-action-cards.png r4c4–6

questions.asked_clauses: After Looking Glass, what choices are available, how many must be different, and can you choose the draw twice or place Alice in her current or an occupied space? If Alice is SMALL, what is the card’s defense value?
required_answer_facts: Choose 2 different of draw 2, recover 3 health for Alice, place Alice in any other space
Cannot choose draw twice
Placement cannot be current space or occupied space
SMALL Alice defense value 2+1=3

questions.asked_clauses: What condition enables Snicker-Snack’s after-combat hand effect, who sees the hand, who chooses the discarded card, and where does it go? What happens to that effect if Alice loses combat?
required_answer_facts: Requires Alice winning combat
Alice player looks at opponent’s hand and chooses 1 card opponent discards into opponent’s discard pile
No hand/discard effect on loss

questions.asked_clauses: For each of O Frabjous Day!, The Other Side of the Mushroom, I’m Late I’m Late, and Mad as a Hatter, state the after-combat movement (who and maximum distance, if any) and size effect. Can these size changes alter the attack damage already resolved?
required_answer_facts: O Frabjous Day changes size with no movement
Other Side moves Alice up to 3 then changes size
I’m Late moves Alice up to 5 then changes size
Mad as a Hatter moves each own fighter up to 2 then changes size
All size changes mandatory and after current damage, so not retroactive

questions.asked_clauses: Manxome Foe is played with printed value 3 and its during-combat discard reveals a card of combat value 5 and BOOST 2. Which card is discarded from where, what is Manxome Foe’s value before other modifiers, and does that discard count as drawing a card?
required_answer_facts: Discard top card of own deck during combat into own discard pile
Add BOOST 2, not combat value 5: value 3+2=5 before other modifiers
Discard is not a draw

questions.asked_clauses: Jabberwock uses Claws That Catch against a hero, then in a separate combat against a sidekick. What is its combat value in each case before other modifiers, and does Alice being BIG add to either?
required_answer_facts: Against hero value 5 instead of 3
Against sidekick value 3
Alice size does not modify Jabberwock’s cards

questions.asked_clauses: Arthur attacks with Noble Sacrifice, committing a BOOST-2 card through his ability and later discarding a BOOST-3 card through Noble Sacrifice. If uncancelled, what is the attack value and when is each boost chosen? If a defending Feint cancels Noble Sacrifice, which boosts survive and what is the attack value?
required_answer_facts: Ability BOOST chosen face down alongside attack before reveal
Noble Sacrifice optional extra BOOST chosen during combat
Uncancelled value 2+2+3=7
Defending Feint cancels Noble Sacrifice effect and nullifies ability BOOST, which is discarded; no during-combat extra BOOST permitted; value remains printed 2

questions.asked_clauses: Who may play The Lady of the Lake, what named card does it retrieve from which locations to where, when must you shuffle, and what are Excalibur’s user, type and printed attack value?
required_answer_facts: Arthur plays Lady of Lake scheme
Search own deck and discard for Excalibur, add to hand
Shuffle deck if searched deck
Excalibur Arthur-only attack value 6

questions.asked_clauses: After an uncancelled The Aid of Morgana, do you draw only if Arthur won? How many cards, at what timing, and who is allowed to play it?
required_answer_facts: Arthur-only attack
After combat draw 2 mandatory whether won or lost, if game continues

questions.asked_clauses: Who can play Divine Intervention, as what combat-card type, and whom does it move how far at which timing? Must that fighter have won?
required_answer_facts: Arthur-only versatile usable attack or defense
After combat move Arthur up to 5; no win condition

questions.asked_clauses: Who plays Prophecy, what happens to the top four cards, and in what order may cards be returned to the deck? Is this a scheme or an attack?
required_answer_facts: Merlin-only scheme
Look top 4 of own deck; add 2 to hand; return other 2 atop own deck in any order

questions.asked_clauses: For Bewilderment, name its legal fighter, card type and printed defense value; state its during-combat effect and optional after-combat placement, including destination occupancy. Does its printed zero automatically make the attacker win?
required_answer_facts: Merlin-only defense value 0
During combat prevent all damage
After combat may place Merlin in any unoccupied space
Prevented attack damage means defender wins despite zero printed defense; zero alone does not make attacker win

questions.asked_clauses: Who plays Aid the Chosen One, what type/value is it, and what happens after combat on a win versus a loss?
required_answer_facts: Merlin-only attack value 4
If won draw 2 after combat
If lost no draw from this effect

questions.asked_clauses: For Restless Spirits, who is the active fighter, where must the chosen space be, which spaces and fighters take how much damage, and how many cards are drawn if zero, one or two opposing fighters are defeated? If the opposing hero is defeated, do you finish the draw?
required_answer_facts: Merlin plays scheme
Choose space in Merlin’s zone and one space adjacent to that chosen space; deal 2 to each opposing fighter in those two spaces
Zero defeated: no draw; one or two defeated: draw 1 total
Opposing hero defeated ends game immediately before further draw

questions.asked_clauses: Who plays Command the Storms, which fighters can it move how far, and when moving an opposing fighter which side’s fighters can it pass through and which block it?
required_answer_facts: Merlin-only scheme
Move each fighter including opposing up to 3
For opposing fighter use owner perspective: can pass its friendly fighters, cannot pass its enemies; cannot end occupied

questions.asked_clauses: Can Merlin use Swift Strike, which fighter does it move, how far and when, and does it require a combat win?
required_answer_facts: ANY allows Merlin
After combat move the fighter that used it up to 4
No win condition

questions.asked_clauses: Medusa attacks using Gaze of Stone (value 2) against an uncancelled defense value 2, then in a separate combat against no defense. Assuming no other modifiers and a surviving target, state attack damage, combat winner and Gaze’s extra damage in each case.
required_answer_facts: Against defense 2 attack damage 0, defender wins, no Gaze extra 8
Undefended attack damage 2, Medusa wins, after combat deal 8 extra to opposing fighter if game continues

questions.asked_clauses: Who plays A Momentary Glance, when does it deal how much damage, what determines its target’s location, and may it target a friendly fighter instead of an opponent?
required_answer_facts: Medusa-only scheme resolves its effect on scheme action
Deal 2 damage to any one fighter in Medusa’s zone
Any includes friendly; not restricted to opponents

questions.asked_clauses: Who can use Hiss and Slither versus Clutching Claws, what are their card types, and what happens after combat? Must you win, and does either printed effect let you choose the opponent’s discard or make it random?
required_answer_facts: Hiss Medusa-only defense; Clutching Harpy-only versatile
After combat opponent discards 1 regardless of win
Neither says you choose or random; opponent discards their chosen card

questions.asked_clauses: Who can play The Hounds of Mighty Zeus, what type and value is it, and after combat does it move just the fighting Harpy or all Harpies, for how far? Can Medusa play it herself?
required_answer_facts: Harpy-only versatile value 4
After combat move each Harpy up to 3
Medusa cannot play it

questions.asked_clauses: When may Second Shot be BOOSTed, who may use it and what is its type/base value? If you discard a BOOST-2 card, what is the attack value and what happens to the discarded card’s effect?
required_answer_facts: Medusa-only attack value 3
During combat optional BOOST by discarding 1 hand card
Add 2 gives 5; ignore discarded card effect

questions.asked_clauses: Can a Harpy use Dash as defense, who moves afterward, what is the maximum movement, and must that Harpy win for the movement to occur if it survives?
required_answer_facts: ANY versatile permits Harpy defense
After combat move that fighting Harpy up to 3, not all fighters
No win condition

questions.asked_clauses: Who may use Snipe and in which combat roles, and what does it do after combat on a loss as well as a win?
required_answer_facts: ANY fighter may use versatile Snipe attacking or defending
After combat draw 1, on loss as well as win if game continues

questions.asked_clauses: Who may use Toil and Danger and in which combat roles, and what does it move how far at what timing? Does Sinbad’s Voyage-count maneuver bonus increase that card’s printed movement?
required_answer_facts: Sinbad-only versatile may attack or defend
After combat move Sinbad up to 3
Voyage-count movement ability applies when maneuvering, so does not increase this card’s move

questions.asked_clauses: Who may play Riches Beyond Compare, what action does it use, and what is its mandatory effect? With 8 cards after resolving it midturn, must you immediately discard?
required_answer_facts: Sinbad-only scheme
Draw 3 mandatory
No immediate hand-limit discard midturn; enforce 7 at turn end

questions.asked_clauses: Who may use By Fortune and Fate, what type/value is it, and what does it do after combat? If Porter is defeated but Sinbad lives, may you initiate it as an attack, and may the unusable card still BOOST?
required_answer_facts: Porter-only attack value 3; after combat draw 2 without win condition
Defeated Porter cannot initiate an attack with it; card still usable to pay BOOST

questions.asked_clauses: Compare Commanding Impact and Exploit: allowed users, combat type/value, and their after-combat effects. Do their draws require winning?
required_answer_facts: Both ANY
Commanding Impact attack value 5; Exploit versatile value 4
Both after combat draw 1 without win requirement

questions.asked_clauses: For Leap Away, what type/value and permitted users does it have, and what happens after a win versus a loss? Which fighter can be moved how far, and do normal blockers apply if you move an opponent?
required_answer_facts: ANY versatile value 4
If won after combat choose either fighter in combat and move up to 4
Loss gives no movement
Opponent movement obeys owner-relative normal blockers and no occupied endpoint

questions.asked_clauses: After Voyage to the Island That Was a Whale, who recovers how much health, is a combat win required, and what if Sinbad is already at 14 health or has been defeated?
required_answer_facts: After combat Sinbad recovers 2 without win condition
At 14 capped at 15
Defeated Sinbad has already lost duel so cannot be saved

questions.asked_clauses: What exactly does Voyage to the Valley of the Giant Snakes do after combat, does it require a win, and does it discard a card from that hand?
required_answer_facts: Look at opponent’s hand after combat regardless of win
No discard effect

questions.asked_clauses: What exactly happens after Voyage to the Creature with Eyes Like Coals of Fire, who loses the card, how is it selected, and is a combat win required?
required_answer_facts: After combat opponent discards 1 random card
No win requirement

questions.asked_clauses: What movement does Voyage to the Cannibals with the Root of Madness allow after combat, who moves, is it optional, and must Sinbad have won?
required_answer_facts: After combat may move Sinbad up to 2
Optional and no win requirement

questions.asked_clauses: What happens after Voyage to the City of the Man-Eating Apes if Sinbad lost combat but is alive and the duel continues? Can the 2 damage from this effect change who won the combat?
required_answer_facts: Deal 2 damage to opposing fighter after combat even on loss
Effect damage does not change combat winner

questions.asked_clauses: What happens after Voyage to the City of the King of Serendib, when and for whose hand, and must Sinbad win first?
required_answer_facts: After combat draw 1 into own hand, mandatory without win requirement if duel continues

questions.asked_clauses: A required draw of 2 begins with one card left in your deck and all fighters alive. What happens to the first and second draws, does an empty deck alone deal damage before a draw is requested, and does the discard pile get shuffled?
required_answer_facts: First draw takes remaining card into hand
Second missing draw deals 2 to each own fighter immediately
Empty deck alone marks exhausted but deals no damage until a draw required
No reshuffle

questions.asked_clauses: Both combatants play Feint. Which immediately effect resolves first, what happens to the other Feint’s effect, and do the printed combat values vanish?
required_answer_facts: Defender’s immediately effect first cancels attacker Feint effects
Attacker cancellation does not resolve
Printed values remain; only effects canceled
source_refs: all four action sheets Feint; rulebook p12

questions.asked_clauses: BIG Alice attacks with O Frabjous Day! against defense 4 with no other effects. What is Alice’s attack value and attack damage, when does size change, and what bonus applies to her next defense while SMALL?
required_answer_facts: Attack value 4+2=6 and attack damage 2
Change BIG to SMALL after combat, after damage
Next SMALL defense has +1 value
